Non-standard task list extension tests: task marks holding any
character, and named task marks.

-- parser.json --
{"TaskList": true, "TaskMark": true, "TaskName": true}
-- mark.md --
- [ ] todo
- [x] done
- [X] done
- [u] unknown
- [T] spawn
- [?] huh
- [✓] check
-- mark.html --
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> todo</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> done</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> done</li>
<li><input data-mark="u" disabled="" type="checkbox"> unknown</li>
<li><input data-mark="T" disabled="" type="checkbox"> spawn</li>
<li><input data-mark="?" disabled="" type="checkbox"> huh</li>
<li><input data-mark="✓" disabled="" type="checkbox"> check</li>
</ul>
-- markesc.md --
- [&] amp
-- markesc.html --
<ul>
<li><input data-mark="&amp;" disabled="" type="checkbox"> amp</li>
</ul>
-- nomark.md --
- [] empty
- [ab] two
- []] bracket
- [u]tight
-- nomark.html --
<ul>
<li>[] empty</li>
<li>[ab] two</li>
<li>[]] bracket</li>
<li>[u]tight</li>
</ul>
-- name.md --
- [ ].a foo
- [x].ab bar
- [t].a baz
- [ ].afoo qux
-- name.html --
<ul>
<li><input data-name="a" disabled="" type="checkbox"> foo</li>
<li><input checked="" data-name="ab" disabled="" type="checkbox"> bar</li>
<li><input data-mark="t" data-name="a" disabled="" type="checkbox"> baz</li>
<li><input data-name="afoo" disabled="" type="checkbox"> qux</li>
</ul>
-- noname.md --
- [ ].A foo
- [ ]. a foo
- [ ]. foo
- [ ].afoo
- [ ]..a foo
-- noname.html --
<ul>
<li>[ ].A foo</li>
<li>[ ]. a foo</li>
<li>[ ]. foo</li>
<li>[ ].afoo</li>
<li>[ ]..a foo</li>
</ul>
